title: Cartwise+ Membership Priority Delivery Upgrade Rules
content:
At the start of each paid period, a Cartwise+ Membership plan whose Priority Delivery upgrade allotment is above 0 is allotted that many Priority Delivery upgrades; plans with an allotment of 0 receive no allotment entry. Unused upgrades lapse at the end of the period, because no plan carries unused upgrades into the next period.

An upgrade is redeemed on a Priority Delivery order placed while the membership is trialing or active; it replaces that order's Priority fee in full and uses exactly one upgrade. An upgrade cannot be redeemed when the upgrades remaining are 0, and one order uses at most one upgrade — an order that already shows an upgrade-redemption entry cannot use a second. A redeemed upgrade is returned only when the order is canceled before shopping starts.

## Redemption conditions

| Condition | Must hold |
|---|---|
| Order service level | Priority Delivery |
| Membership status when the order was placed | trialing or active |
| Upgrades remaining | above 0 |
| Upgrades already used on this order | none |

## Hypothetical illustration

A plan allotted 4 upgrades at the period start, with 1 remaining. A Priority Delivery order placed while active uses that last upgrade: its Priority fee is replaced in full and the upgrades remaining become 0. A second Priority Delivery order in the same period cannot use an upgrade. If the first order is canceled before shopping starts, its upgrade is returned. At the period end any upgrades left lapse and the next period starts with a fresh allotment.

The allotment per plan is the one in the Priority Delivery upgrade allotment table.
